description: Record the investor's completed decision: proceeded, abandoned or deferred, with optional note and broker reference. One record per check. Does not place or change orders.

broker_reference.description: Optional. The investor's own order reference. Never used to reach a broker.

check_id.description: The check_id check_action returned for this change.

note.description: Optional. The investor's own remark on the decision.

outcome.description: What the investor did: proceeded (carried it out), abandoned (dropped it) or deferred (put it off). Tell the investor in those words, not the code. Final once saved, so confirm it with them first.

name: record_decision
title: Record a stated decision
